title: Bookeeper
description:
Position Summary



The Bookkeeper will be responsible for recording financial transactions, managing accounts payable and receivable, reconciling accounts, assisting with payroll, and supporting overall financial operations. The ideal candidate is organized, reliable, and experienced with bookkeeping software such as QuickBooks Online.



Key Responsibilities

Accounts Receivable

Create and send invoices to customers.

Monitor outstanding balances and follow up on overdue accounts.

Record customer payments and maintain accurate records.

Prepare accounts receivable aging reports.

Accounts Payable

Enter supplier invoices and expenses.

Verify and process payments to vendors and subcontractors.

Maintain organized records of bills, receipts, and purchase orders.

Track due dates and ensure timely payments.

Bank & Credit Card Reconciliation

Investigate and resolve discrepancies.

Maintain accurate cash flow records.

Payroll Support

Track employee hours and contractor payments.

Ensure payroll records are accurate and compliant.

Financial Reporting

Prepare monthly profit and loss statements.

Generate balance sheets and cash flow reports.

Maintain job costing records for construction projects.

Assist with budgeting and financial planning.

Administrative Duties

Maintain digital filing systems and financial records.

Assist with GST filings and year-end preparation.

Coordinate with accountants and external professionals.

Support management with financial analysis and reporting.

Qualifications

Minimum 2 years bookkeeping experience.

Experience with QuickBooks Online preferred.

Strong knowledge of Canadian bookkeeping practices.

Understanding of construction job costing is an asset.

Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.

Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Ability to handle confidential financial information.

title: Ticket Buyer
description:
We are hiring a Ticket Buyer for our client, an established ticket brokerage that purchases and resells event inventory across sports, concerts, and live entertainment.



This role is for someone who already understands the ticket industry. You know that timing matters. You know that the right seats can make or break a deal. You know that moving fast, staying organized, and spotting opportunities before others do can turn a smart purchase into strong returns.



Our client has built a successful business by identifying the right inventory at the right time. They are now looking for a sharp, self-driven operator who can help research, purchase, and manage ticket inventory with a high level of ownership.



A Day in This Role



You start early, when the most important on-sales are happening.



You review the day's events, check ticketing platforms, evaluate target sections, and make sure everything is prepared before inventory goes live.



A major sporting event is about to drop. You understand the team, the venue, the demand, and which sections are worth pursuing. You move quickly, secure inventory, document purchases accurately, and stay organized without constant oversight.



Later in the day, you research upcoming games, concerts, and events that may present strong buying opportunities. You identify patterns, evaluate risk, and share recommendations with the founder.



You finish the day with clean records, fresh opportunities, and inventory positioned for future resale.



What You'll Do



You will help research, purchase, and organize ticket inventory.



Responsibilities include:

??Purchasing tickets through Ticketmaster, AXS, and other major ticketing platforms

??Researching sports, concerts, and live events for strong buying opportunities

??Tracking purchases, inventory, and key details in Google Sheets

??Moving quickly during on-sales and high-demand releases

??Evaluating seat quality, demand, risk, and resale potential

??Supporting ticketing operations, account management, and administrative workflows

??Communicating clearly with the founder regarding opportunities, purchases, and recommendations

??Staying organized without constant follow-up

??Proactively identifying opportunities and suggesting ideas



You're a Great Fit If

??You have ticket buying, ticket pulling, or ticket brokerage experience

??You understand Ticketmaster, AXS, Live Nation, StubHub, Vivid Seats, and similar platforms

??You can perform well during high-demand ticket releases

??You are confident using Google Sheets or Excel

??You understand supply, demand, seat quality, and event value

??You are resourceful and can work independently

??You have strong English communication skills

??You have reliable internet and a strong computer setup

??You can consistently work during key US morning hours



This Role Is Not for You If

??You have no ticket buying experience

??You need to be taught the ticket business from scratch

??You require step-by-step direction for every task

??You struggle under pressure during live on-sales

??You are disorganized with tracking and documentation

??You do not follow sports, concerts, or live entertainment

??You require heavy daily management



Bonus Points If You Have

??Experience working for a ticket broker or ticketing company

??Experience with Jancy Browser

??Strong knowledge of US sports, especially basketball, football, baseball, or playoff events

??Experience buying inventory across multiple ticketing and resale platforms

??Experience managing ticketing workflows and operational processes

??A strong eye for profitable opportunities



Why This Role Is Exciting

??You'll join a business where strong decisions can create meaningful results

??You'll work directly with the founder and earn trust quickly

??You'll have ownership beyond basic administrative tasks

??You'll play a key role in research, purchasing, and opportunity identification

??You'll help strengthen and scale the buying operation

??Strong performers will have opportunities to grow with the business

title: Billing Support Analyst - Remote
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading. We're doing it with a technology-forward approach, actively developing the AI infrastructure that will make this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

The Billing Support Analyst is the financial backbone of MedPro Disposal’s client lifecycle — ensuring every account is billed accurately, every discrepancy is resolved promptly, and every month-end close is executed without gaps. This role is designed for a tenured billing professional who owns their work end-to-end: from new account setup and billing audits to specialty program management and inbox triage, with the precision and autonomy that keeps the organization’s revenue engine running clean. Success means zero billing errors reaching clients, faster resolution cycles, and a finance team that can scale confidently because its foundation is airtight.



Key Responsibilities:

1.  New Customer Set-Up

• Set up new customer accounts in the billing system, ensuring accurate entry of service agreements, contact details, and pricing schedules.

• Process pending business set-up through to completion upon receipt of hauler confirmation.

• Verify account completeness before the first billing cycle to prevent setup-related invoice errors.



2.  Audit Billing / Reconciliation

• Audit billing records for accuracy, identifying discrepancies, missing charges, or data entry errors.

• Reconcile account data between service records and billing entries to maintain clean, reliable account histories.

• Review customer usage data to identify over-allotment occurrences and generate accurate additional charges across service types:

? Third-party hauler over-allotment

? Per container charges

? Pharmaceutical billing

? Hazardous waste billing

? Other applicable service types as assigned



3.  Finance / Mailback Support Tasks

• Provide Level 2 and Level 3 billing support, resolving escalated issues beyond frontline scope.

• Support mailback program billing and related finance tasks as assigned.



4.  Billing Inbox Management

• Monitor the billing inbox daily, triaging and routing incoming requests to the appropriate tea
mber or queue.

• Communicate with internal teams — including Sales, Operations, and Customer Service — to resolve account setup questions and billing discrepancies.



5.  Month-End Close Support

• Assist with month-end close activities including charge posting, invoice review, and reconciliation tasks.

• Pull invoices and account data to support close reporting and ad-hoc management requests within defined turnaround windows.



6.  Specialty Billing Account Support

• Support billing operations for specialty accounts, adhering to each account’s unique invoicing rules, contract terms, and reporting requirements.

• Ensure accuracy and timeliness across specialty program billing cycles, including:

? Premise

? Humana

? Conviva

? Tempus

? Additional specialty accounts as assigned



Qualifications

Required:

• Minimum 3-5 years of billing, accounts receivable, or finance operations experience; prior remote/offshore work for a US-based employer strongly preferred.

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Proficient in Salesforce CRM and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel at intermediate-to-advanced level required).

• Demonstrated ability to work independently and manage billing workflows with minimal supervision — this role is not a training position.

• Exceptional attention to detail with a track record of catching and correcting data discrepancies before they reach clients.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills — comfortable corresponding directly with US-based internal teams.

• Comfortable with US business hours (CST) and experienced working across time zones in a remote-first environment.



Nice-to-Have:

• Experience with Striven ERP or similar recurring billing platforms.

• Familiarity with medical waste, healthcare compliance, or regulated-industry billing.

• Exposure to specialty account billing with unique contract terms or invoicing rules.



Compensation & Benefits:

• Salary Range: $4.50-$5.50/hr

title: Customer Service Specialist / Virtual Service Advisor
description:
Customer Service Specialist / Virtual Service Advisor

Automotive Support. Full training provided. No car experience needed

Company: WorkWise Auto Solutions PTY LTD

Location: Remote Set-Up



About WorkWise Auto Solutions



WorkWise Auto Solutions is transforming how automotive workshops operate. We help shop owners streamline their workflow, reduce administrative stress, and increase profitability through a combination of smart systems and human support.

Our core service revolves around Virtual Service Advisors (VSAs) who handle customer communication, booking triage, job approvals, and workflow optimisation. We also build internal tools, marketing assets, and client-facing platforms to support that mission, and that’s where you come in.



You do not need to know anything about cars. We will train you fully.



A Virtual Service Advisor (VSA) is the organised, friendly engine room of an Australian auto workshop. You are the calm voice that their customers talk to, and the person quietly keeping the day on track behind the scenes by booking jobs, sorting parts, preparing quotes and invoices, and making sure nothing slips through the cracks.

It is about a third customer conversation and two-thirds careful, methodical follow-through inside the workshop's systems. We will teach you every tool. What we cannot teach is the mix we are really after: warmth with people, and the kind of mind that closes every loop.



Is this you?

 - You communicate clearly and warmly in English, in writing and on a call.

 - You stay calm and helpful when someone is annoyed, confused, or in a hurry.

 - You close the loop. If you order a part, you track it until it arrives. Nothing gets forgotten.

 - You are comfortable living inside software all day and learning new systems quickly.

 - You can juggle lots of small tasks accurately, under a bit of pressure, without dropping any.

 - You want a long-term, stable role, not a quick gig.

If that sounds like you, we would genuinely love to meet you, automotive background or not.



What you'll do day to day

 - Triage incoming enquiries and manage the workshop's diary and daily capacity.

 - Source, quote, order, and follow up with suppliers, and chase ETAs.

 - Prepare estimates and quotes, and send them to customers.

 - Build and organise job cards and bookings in the workshop's system.

 - Finalise jobs by tidying the details, raising invoices, and sending payment links.

 - Handle customer messages, voi
s, and work approvals warmly and promptly.

 - Own your day with a quick morning plan, a heads-up at lunch, and a clear end-of-day wrap.



Two real 
nts from the role: 

   -  The upset customer

          "A customer was promised their car by 3 pm. It is 2:30 and the part has not arrived. They message upset, because they need the car for work tomorrow. How do you handle that conversation?"

     - The part that didn't show

          "You ordered a part three days ago and the customer is booked in tomorrow morning. It still has not arrived and the supplier has not updated you. What do you do today, not tomorrow?"



If you already have an instinct for both of these, calm and honest with the customer, and proactive and a step ahead on the parts, you will do well here. That instinct matters to us more than a polished resume.



Why you'll like it here

 - Full on-the-job training. No automotive knowledge required to start.

 - 100% remote. Work from anywhere in the Philippines.

 - Australian day-shift hours, so your evenings and family time stay yours.

 - Real growth. Many of our team have moved into senior and specialist roles.

 - A supportive team that values clear communication and genuine care for clients.





How to apply

Applications are only reviewed through the form below, not via
 or this post.

Apply here:  
  

Select “Virtual Service Advisor” as the position.



Two things we read first, so please don't skip them:

1. In your short intro video, pick either scenario above and talk us through exactly what you would do.

2. Tell us about one time you stayed on top of a messy, multi-step task and made sure nothing slipped.

Generic, recycled VA applications get filtered out. We are looking for the person behind the answers.

title: Social Media Content Manager VA for Mental Health Practice — Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, YouTube
description:
# Social Media Content Manager / Virtual Assistant for Mental Health Practice



We are looking for a reliable, creative, and detail-oriented Social Media Content Manager / Virtual Assistant to help grow the online presence of our mental health and psychiatry practice, Ravora Health.



Ravora Health is a telehealth psychiatry practice focused on helping patients with anxiety, depression, ADHD, medication management, and mental wellness. We want to build a strong, trustworthy, educational, and professional brand across social media.



This role is ideal for someone who understands content creation, social media growth, short-form video, Canva design, captions, scheduling, and platform-specific posting.



## Platforms We Need Help With



You will help create and manage content for:



* Instagram

*

* TikTok

* X /

* YouTube Shorts

* Google Business Profile, preferred but not required



## Main Responsibilities



You will be responsible for helping us create, organize, and publish consistent content across multiple platforms.



Responsibilities may include:



* Creating a weekly and monthly content calendar

* Designing Instagram/Facebook graphics, carousels, quote posts, and infographics

* Creating Instagram stories and story templates

* Writing captions for mental health and psychiatry-related content

* Creating short-form videos, Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts

* Repurposing content across Instagram,
, TikTok, X, and YouTube

* Creating faceless educational videos when provider video footage is not available

* Using Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar tools

* Helping generate content ideas based on mental health topics

* Researching competitor content and trending healthcare/wellness content

* Scheduling posts after approval

* Tracking basic performance metrics

* Providing a weekly content summary and recommendations



## Content Expectations



We are trying to grow, so we need someone who can produce consistent content volume.



We are aiming for approximately 5–9 published content touchpoints per day across all platforms.



This does not mean 9 completely unique posts every day. We expect smart repurposing across platforms.



For example, a single educational topic may become:



* 1 Instagram carousel

* 1
 post

* 1 X thread or several short X posts

* 1 TikTok/Reel/Short

* 3–5 Instagram/Facebook stories



## Weekly Minimum Deliverables



At minimum, we would like help producing:



* 5–7 Instagram main posts per week

* 20–35 Instagram/Facebook stories per week

* 5–7
 posts per week

* 3–5 TikToks/Reels/YouTube Shorts per week to start

* 15–25 X posts per week

* 3–5 YouTube Shorts per week

* 1 weekly content calendar

* 1 weekly performance summary

* 10–20 new content ideas for future posts



As we create more video content with our provider, we would like to increase short-form video production.



## Content Topics



Content will focus on topics such as:



* Anxiety

* Depression

* ADHD

* Medication management

* Telehealth psychiatry

* Mental health education

* What to expect as a new patient

* Psychiatry myths

* Therapy vs psychiatry

* Self-care and coping skills

* Appointment availability

* Local New Jersey mental health content

* Patient FAQs



## Important Healthcare Content Rules



Because this is a healthcare practice, content must be professional, ethical, and compliant.



You must not create or post:



* Fake patient stories

* Fake testimonials

* Patient information

* Screenshots of patient messages

* Medical guarantees such as “we cure anxiety” or “fix ADHD fast”

* Fear-based medical claims

* Misleading or exaggerated health claims

* Clinical advice in comments or DMs

* Content copied from other creators



All clinical or educational content must be reviewed and approved before publishing.



## Required Skills



Please apply only if you have experience with at least some of the following:



* Social media content creation

* Canva

* Caption writing

* Content calendars

* Instagram/Facebook posting

* TikTok/Reels/YouTube Shorts

* CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar video editing software

* Basic social media analytics

* Researching content ideas

* Repurposing content across platforms

* Strong written English

* Reliable communication

* Ability to follow instructions and meet deadlines



Healthcare, wellness, mental health, coaching, or professional services experience is a plus.



## Preferred Skills



The ideal candidate may also have experience with:



* AI content tools

* AI video tools

* HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Veo, CapCut, or similar tools

* Google Business Profile posts

* SEO-friendly social captions

* Short-form video hooks

* UGC-style videos

* Faceless educational videos

* Brand voice development



## Hours and Pay



We are open to part-time support to start.



Please include your hourly rate or monthly rate in your application.



We are looking for someone affordable but reliable. If the work is high quality and consistent, this can grow into a long-term role.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your social media/content creation experience

3. Examples of posts, graphics, carousels, videos, captions, or content calendars you personally created

4. Any healthcare, wellness, mental health, coaching, or professional-service content examples

5. A short explanation of your content creation process

6. A short screen-recording video showing you creating a sample post, editing a sample video, or walking through one of your previous projects

7. Your availability and preferred work schedule

8. Your expected monthly or hourly rate

9. The tools you use, such as Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro, ChatGPT, etc.



The screen-recording video is important. We want to make sure applicants can actually create original content and are not just copying/pasting from templates or using someone else’s portfolio.



## Paid Test Project



Before hiring, we may ask selected applicants to complete a small paid test project.



The test project may include:



* 3 social media post ideas for Ravora Health

* 1 Canva carousel

* 1 short caption

* 1 Instagram story set

* 1 short-form video or video concept



We are looking for someone who can help us build a consistent, trustworthy, warm, and professional mental health brand online.

title: Instagram DM Setter
description:
DM Setter 

Set calls for a 150K athlete-founder brand · Remote · Full-Time

I need someone who can live in my DMs, sound exactly like me, and turn conversations into booked calls. Chill, sharp, and obsessed with results.

Read this whole thing. There's a keyword near the bottom — if you skip it, I'll know, and you won't get a reply.



Who I am

I'm Jonas. I 
 — around 150K followers across Instagram and YouTube, built on calisthenics, performance, and the athlete-founder lifestyle. The brand is in English, the audience is global, and the DMs never stop coming in.

That's where you come in.

What this role is

I'm hiring one full-time DM Setter to own my Instagram inbox. Your job: talk to the people sliding into my DMs, build real rapport, qualify them, and book the right ones onto calls for my different offers. 

Not spammy. Not robotic. You sound like me — relaxed, confident, human. This isn't "paste this script 200 times." It's reading people, holding an actual conversation, and getting the qualified ones onto the calendar.

What you'll actually do



Manage and reply to inbound IG DMs (story replies, comment-to-DM, cold inbound)

Build rapport and qualify leads in my voice — casual, chill, never salesy-cringe

Book qualified prospects onto calls and protect the calendar (right people only)

Follow up with leads who go quiet — the money is in the follow-up

Keep the CRM clean and every single lead tracked

Report your numbers every week and actually own them



Who you are



You write English like a native — and you can sound casual and natural, not corporate

You've set before, and you can prove it (more on that below)

You pick up someone's voice fast and can mirror it

You're proactive. You spot problems and fix them without being told. If you need to be micromanaged, this isn't for you.

You're organized, reliable, and you basically live in your inbox

Bonus: you actually care about fitness / calisthenics / the performance space



The non-negotiable: show me proof

I don't care about a fancy CV. I care about results. To even be considered, you need to show me real data from your past setting work:



Calls booked (per week / per month)

Show rate

Screenshots of actual DM conversations you turned into bookings





Hours & setup



Full-time: 35–40 hours/week

Remote





What you get



[BASE] + [COMMISSION per booked / showed call] — real upside, you eat what you kill

Direct access to me — you work with the founder, not a manager

A fast-growing brand with constant inbound — you'll never run out of conversations

Room to grow as the brand and the offers scale



How to apply (read carefully — this is the filter)

Lazy applications get deleted. If you want this, show me you're different:

1. Loom video (2–3 min). Tell me who you are, walk me through your setting results, and show me the proof on screen — numbers, screenshots, dashboards, whatever you've got. I want to hear it and see it.

2. The writing test. Below is a real-style inbound DM. Reply the way you'd reply if you were me — chill, natural, and move it toward a call:



"yo just saw your reel on the planche progression ???? been training calisthenics for like 8 months but kinda stuck. is your program for someone at my level?"



Write your reply exactly as you'd send it.

3. Proof attached. Screenshots / data of your past results.

contentgrove helps creators see which videos actually drive clicks, conversions, and sales, so they can stop guessing and make better content and business decisions.

This role is best for someone who enjoys writing, research, and business development, and who can work carefully without sounding spammy or robotic.



The upside in this role comes from bringing in real paying customers. If you can consistently turn outreach into signups that become paid users, your commission can grow meaningfully over time.



Compensation

This role includes a fixed base of USD 200/month plus 50% recurring commission on any paying customers you personally bring in through your outreach. Commission is paid on collected subscription revenue only, starts once a trial converts into a paid user, and continues for up to 12 months per customer as long as that customer stays active. This is designed to give you both a stable base and strong upside if you can consistently bring in real users.



Who you will contact

- YouTube consultants and strategists who work with creator clients

- Creator-focused agencies

- Selected YouTube creators who actively sell a product, offer, or service



What you will do

- Research and build targeted lead lists based on clear criteria

- Find the right decision-maker for each lead

- Write and send personalized outreach messages through
 or LinkedIn

- Track all outreach activity in a shared spreadsheet or CRM

- Flag warm leads and positive replies quickly

- Help guide qualified leads into a trial and eventually a paid plan

- Share feedback on objections, patterns, and messaging that seem to work



What we are looking for

- Excellent written English

- Strong research skills and attention to detail

- Comfortable with personalized outreach, not copy-paste spam

- Organized and dependable

- Able to work independently and give clear updates

- Comfortable using Google Sheets or similar tools

- Good judgment about who is and is not a strong fit



Nice to have

- Able to use AI and Agents to improve workflows

- Experience with lead generation, outreach, SDR work, or appointment setting

- Familiarity with creators, YouTube, online education, coaching, or digital products

- Experience using LinkedIn for business outreach

- Experience with
 outreach and follow-up



How to Apply

1. Change the subject line to "Let's groove together"



2. At the top of your message, write 2-3 sentences on why you would like this position and why you are a good fit.



3. Under that, answer the following questions (include the numbers for clarity):

a. 1-2 examples of outreach, lead gen, research, or appointment-setting work you have done

c. How frequently do you use AI for your job?

Thanks, I’m excited to see your application!



Markus

Billing & Claims Management: You will verify insurance coverage, benefits, deductibles, and co-pays while obtaining necessary authorizations and re-authorizations for services as needed. You'll prepare and submit billing across multiple cycles (daily, weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly) to various funding sources, including clearinghouses, regional center e-billing systems, and school funding sources when applicable.



Accuracy & Submission: I need you to review all claims, patient bills, and invoices for completeness and accuracy before submission to avoid unnecessary delays. You’ll monitor claim acceptance and resolve any missing or incomplete information.



Collections & Follow-ups: You’ll review EOBs for payment accuracy and proactively research issues such as underpayments, overpayments, denials, and patient responsibility discrepancies. Account Maintenance: You will post charges, process payments, perform account reconciliations, and audit patient responsibility balances daily to ensure timely collections. You'll prepare and send patient statements and manage collections for unpaid accounts.

, communicate outstanding balances to internal staff, and maintain clear documentation of billing activity, including claims follow-ups and patient communications.

Experience handling collections and patient account management

title: Full-time Court Portal Researcher Remote | Full time | $2.00–$2.75/hr USD depending on experience
description:
Full-time Court Portal Researcher

Remote | Full time | $2.00–$2.75/hr USD depending on experience



About the role



We are a fast-growing document preparation company that monitors public court records across the United States. We need a sharp, fast, and reliable full-time researcher whose only job is finding and documenting US court portals that meet our criteria.



This is a focused role. You are not building scrapers. You are not entering data. You are researching websites, testing them against a clear checklist, documenting your findings, and delivering results every single day. Speed and accuracy matter equally here.



What you will do



Visit US county court portal websites across multiple states and test each one against our four criteria checklist.



For every portal document the following in our shared Google Sheet:

— Portal URL

— Whether results can be filtered by filing date without entering a name — yes or no

— Whether the defendant or tenant name is visible in search results — yes or no

— Whether the property address is visible in search results — yes or no

— Whether there is a login wall, CAPTCHA, or paywall blocking access — yes or no

— Estimated weekly filing volume based on visible results

— Your classification — Green, Yellow, or Red

— Screenshot or link as evidence



Green means all four criteria are met and a scraper can be built immediately.

Yellow means most criteria are met but something is missing — usually the address.

Red means the portal is blocked, requires login, or is legally restricted.



Deliver a minimum of 5 to 8 fully documented portal assessments per day. Every row must be complete. No blanks. No guessing. If you are unsure classify it as unclear and note why.



What we are looking for



Fast and systematic — you work through portals methodically without getting stuck

Detail oriented — every field filled in accurately every time

Reliable — you show up every day Monday through Friday and communicate proactively

Comfortable navigating US government and court websites

Good written English for clear notes and updates

Stable internet connection



What we are NOT looking for



Someone who researches 2 portals a day and calls it done

Someone who submits incomplete rows

Someone who disappears without notice

Someone who needs constant supervision



Hours and pay



Full time — 40 hours per week — Monday through Friday

$2.00 to $2.75 per hour depending on speed and accuracy

First 30 days probation — rate confirmed at hire

Paid twice a month on the 1st and 15th via Wise or PayPal



How to apply



Send your application to 

Subject line: Court Portal Researcher Application



Include:

1. Your experience with online research and data documentation

2. Confirm you are available full time Monday through Friday

3. Confirm stable internet connection

4. Your expected hourly rate within the range above

5. Answer this question in 2 to 3 sentences: You need to find out if a county court website allows you to search eviction cases by filing date without entering any names. Walk us through exactly how you would test that.

title: Video Editor and Strategist
description:
We're looking for an AI-first video editor and social media strategist who genuinely loves short-form content and shows up with the plan. If you study what's working on each platform, use AI as a daily working partner, and would rather tell us what to make than wait for a shot list, we'd love to hear from you. This role is mainly for Evident Elements, a clean electrolyte brand.



The Role



You'll find and analyze videos across platforms, spot what's performing and why, and give clear direction on what we should be making next. You're not just editing what you're handed. You're d
 what gets made.



You'll edit short-form video knowing what actually performs per platform. A cut that wins on TikTok is not the same cut that wins on Reels or Shorts, and you understand those differences in your bones.



You'll partner with our team to turn that direction into a steady output of content that moves the brand forward. We work as a team to win, and you lead the thinking on your part of it.



What success looks like in the first 30 to 60 days: you're showing up with a point of view. You can tell us what's working, what isn't, and what you want to test next. You've spotted patterns in our content and competitors' content that we hadn't, and you're driving the content direction rather than waiting on a brief. The bar is strategic ownership, not task completion.



Schedule



You'll work part-time hours that fall somewhere between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST. We'll set the exact schedule together. Just want to make sure you can work somewhere inside that window.



What We're Looking For



- An AI-first mindset. You use AI as a real working partner every day, and it shows in how you work.

- Independent problem-solving. You think first, use AI to amplify your thinking, and verify before sending anything off.

- A strategy-first approach. You're someone who shows up with the plan and tells us what we should be making, testing, and improving. You partner with our team on execution, but you lead the thinking on your work.

- Platform fluency. You know what does well on TikTok versus Reels versus Shorts, and you can explain why, not just guess.

- A real love for this work. That comes through fast in conversation, and we'd rather hire someone who has it than someone who's just qualified.



How to Apply



A few things we'd love you to do, in order:



1. Please start your reply with the word "Jamal." We use this as a small check to spot applicants who read instructions carefully. Without it, we won't be able to review your application.



2. Record a 5-minute video answering the questions below. No script needed. We just want to get a feel for how you think.



3. Share your full tool stack with self-ratings (1 to 10). List every tool you use in your work, one per line, with a /10 rating. Include editing tools, AI tools, scripting and research tools, content calendar systems, anything you've built around your workflow. We're more interested in what you've built around your work than the big-name platforms. Honesty matters more than scoring high. The video will give us a sense of where you actually are.



4. Walk us through your work history. For your last 2 or 3 clients or accounts:



- What size was the account or channel when you started (followers, views, post volume, whatever metric fits)?

- What did you do for them?

- What was the outcome? Where were they when you started, and where are they now?

- If you have current clients, where are those accounts today?



We're trying to understand how you measure your own impact. The more specific, the better.



5. Quick confirmation that you can work somewhere inside the hours described above.



How You Use AI



In your video, spend a minute or so on this. The more specific the better:



- Which AI tools you use daily, weekly, and occasionally

- A specific example of a task in this role where AI saves you real time, and how you use it

- A time AI gave you a wrong or bad output. How you caught it, and what you did about it

- Anything you've intentionally chosen NOT to let AI do in your work, and why



We're looking for real, lived examples. The specifics tell the story.



A Few Questions for Your Video



Take these in order, and just talk through them naturally.



1. If you joined next week, walk me through how you'd figure out what content we should be making. What would you look at, and what would your first hypothesis to test be?

2. Walk me through how you find and analyze videos to d
 what's worth modeling. What signals tell you a video is actually working versus just got lucky?

3. A short-form video gets strong views but almost no profile visits or saves. How do you diagnose that, and what do you change?

4. Why do you love this work? Tell me about a recent video or 
nt that reminded you why you do it.

5. What's something about short-form right now, on a platform you know well, that most editors are getting wrong or haven't caught up to yet?

Applications without a voice sample, without the code, or without dial-count numbers will be ignored. We listen to every voice sample that follows the instructions.

title: Maintenance Coordinator - Property Management
description:
Maintenance Coordinator (Virtual)

US Residential Property Management | Remote (Philippines) | Full-Time Contractor

QUICK FACTS



Title: Maintenance Coordinator (Virtual)

Reports To: Assistant Property Manager (escalation & approvals)

Location: Remote (Philippines). US Central business-hours overlap required.

Type: Full-time contractor (~40 hrs/week)

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central (US business hours)

Compensation: $1,800–2,100/mo USD (commensurate with experience) + 13th month pay (paid in December, prorated by tenure)

Start Date: ASAP



ABOUT US

We are a growing Austin, Texas–based residential property management company managing 400+ doors — single-family homes and duplexes — across the greater Austin Metro area. We are committed to delivering an exceptional, hands-off ownership experience and great service to our residents. We run on AppFolio and are scaling deliberately, through systems, accountability, and talented people rather than constant management oversight. Every member of our team is expected to use AI daily to work faster, more accurately, and more independently.



THE ROLE

The Maintenance Coordinator owns the end-to-end resolution of maintenance across our portfolio — from intake to closeout — with minimal hand-holding. You are the single point of accountability for work orders: you triage them, coordinate vendors, communicate with residents and owners, and drive each one to completion within target timelines.



You perform your own due diligence and bring decisions to your approver as a clean Yes/No or A/B/C question with full context attached — never an open-ended "what should I do?"



This is not a passive ticket-routing role. We are not looking for a dispatcher; we are looking for someone who owns outcomes. 



This is an individual-contributor role — you personally own and execute the maintenance workflow end to end. You will make sound judgment calls within defined authority limits, anticipate problems before they become emergencies, keep meticulous records, and use AI tools to multiply your output. If you need to be told what to do every day, this is not the right fit.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Work Order Management



-Triage and prioritize all incoming work orders in AppFolio: occupied properties first, then vacant, then annual inspections — adjusting for safety or legal urgency (a leak, no-AC in summer, or fire hazard always moves up).

-Assign new work orders the same day they are received.

-Maintain a continuously updated, color-coded, priority-tagged work-order tracker (with work-order age) so nothing slips and weekly reviews are never a last-minute scramble.

-Drive every work order to closeout as quickly as possible — target under 7 days — and keep aged (7+ day) open orders to a minimum.



Vendor & Repair Coordination



-Source, schedule, and follow up with vendors (plumbers, HVAC, electricians, handymen, etc.); confirm scope, negotiate pricing, and verify quality on completion.

-Gather and review estimates and photos before requesting any approval — always get the full picture first.

-Maintain accurate, current vendor records, including W-9s, certificates of insurance (COIs), and pricing agreements.

-Process and route vendor invoices within 2 business days of receipt.



Resident & Owner Communication



-Respond to resident and owner maintenance inquiries promptly and professionally across all channels.

-For emergencies, call the resident within 30 minutes of receipt and notify them immediately once a vendor is scheduled.

-Keep communication clear and professional (no slang, emojis, or "LOL"). Use AI to polish drafts before sending.

-Read and correctly apply the lease on every relevant work order — the lease defines who is responsible for a repair, what the resident is owed, and the limits of your authority. You are expected to check the lease before making determinations, not after.



Turnovers, Make-Readies & Inspections



-Coordinate make-ready walks within 1 business day of move-out; drive make-readies to completion in a 7–10 business-day target window.

-Collaborate with leasing and field teams on turnover work and move-in repairs.

-Coordinate annual inspections and any follow-up work they surface.



Preventive & Seasonal Readiness



-Drive seasonal property readiness: freeze prep, HVAC inspections, pest control, and similar recurring work.

-Anticipate weather-sensitive issues (a Texas freeze or heat wave) and get ahead of them.



Utilities & Accounting Support



-Assist with paying utility bills online and coordinating utilities during turnovers.

-Support the Accounting team with collecting invoices and vendor invoice adjustments when needed.



Documentation & SOPs



-Save and correctly label all photos (work-order #, property) in JPEG format so anyone on the team can find them.

-Keep your SOP wikis clear and current. The standard: could another tea
mber run this process from your documentation with little to no further support?



SUCCESS METRICS (KPIs)



-New work orders assigned: Same day

-Emergency work orders: Call resident within 30 minutes; notify when vendor scheduled

-Follow-up on open WOs (vendor/resident): Every 1–2 business days until confirmed

-Work order closeout: As soon as possible; within 7 days

-Make-ready walk: Within 1 business day of move-out

-Make-ready completion: 7–10 business days post move-out

-Vendor invoices processed: Within 2 business days of receipt

-Aged work orders (7+ days): Kept to a minimum



AUTHORITY & DECISION RIGHTS



-Repairs $1,000 or under: Full authority — use your best judgment, no approval required.

-Repairs over $1,000: Escalate to your approver with full context (owner notification is required per the management agreement).

-Estimate / work approval: No work proceeds unless you have personally approved it. If you didn't approve it, it isn't approved.

When to escalate: You're genuinely unsure; it's high-consequence or legally sensitive; or it's an emergency (flood, fire, gas leak, etc.). Always frame as Yes/No or A/B/C with photos, estimate, WO #, and context.

-When NOT to escalate: A resident is simply anxious or frustrated, or you can resolve it yourself within your authority.



AI PROFICIENCY — HARD REQUIREMENT

This is not a nice-to-have. Every member of our team uses AI daily, and you will be evaluated on your ability to use AI to work faster and produce higher-quality output.



-Proficient with ChatGPT or Claude for drafting resident, owner, and vendor communications, summarizing, and problem-solving.

-Able to write effective prompts that produce usable first drafts.

-Comfortable using AI to research unfamiliar repair or maintenance situations and synthesize next steps.

-Willing to adopt new AI tools and workflows without hand-holding.

-You will be tested on this in the interview. If you have never used AI tools in a work context, please do not apply.



REQUIREMENTS

Must Have



-Direct maintenance-coordination experience in US residential property management — not general admin or VA work. You have owned work orders end-to-end.

-Hands-on AppFolio experience (work orders, reporting, owner and resident records).

-Strong working knowledge of residential maintenance — HVAC, plumbing, electrical, appliances, and general repairs — including common repair timelines and vendor negotiation.

-Excellent written and spoken English; professional, clear, and calm under pressure with residents, owners, and vendors.

-Strong judgment and ownership — you make decisions within guardrails rather than waiting to be told.

-Meticulous attention to detail and follow-through; you do not drop work orders.

-Demonstrated AI proficiency (ChatGPT, Claude, or equivalent) in a real work context.

-Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional home-office setup.

-Available Monday–Friday, US Central business hours.

-Able to read a residential lease and apply it to real maintenance situations — determining responsibility, obligations, and authority from the lease terms. This is foundational to the role; you will rely on it daily.



Nice to Have



-3+ years of property management maintenance coordination experience.

-Experience creating and improving maintenance processes, workflows, and SOPs.

-Familiarity with HelpScout, Basecamp, and Google Workspace.

-Knowledge of Texas habitability and repair-timeline standards.

-Light automation experience (Zapier / Make) or genuine interest in building systems.



We Will Not Move Forward With Candidates Who



-Lack genuine, specific maintenance-coordination experience (general VA experience alone is not enough; please do not apply if you do not have prior experience in maintenance coordination in a property management company).

-Cannot demonstrate practical lease comprehension — i.e., reading a lease and correctly determining maintenance responsibility and authority.

-Have no demonstrated experience using AI tools at work.

-Require constant direction — this role demands independent judgment within defined limits.

-Cannot communicate clearly and professionally in English, or cannot commit to consistent Central-time hours.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

The person who thrives in this role:



-Takes ownership rather than passing problems to others.

-Solves problems before escalating them.

-Makes sound decisions with limited supervision.

-Holds vendors accountable to scope, price, and quality.

-Improves systems and processes proactively.

-Communicates clearly and professionally.

-Creates confidence among owners, residents, and leadership.



OUR CORE VALUES

-Extreme Ownership · Solutions, Not Excuses · Attention to Detail · Continuous Improvement · Professional Communication · -Accountability · Team-First Mentality



TOOLS YOU WILL USE



-AppFolio (property management / work orders)

-HelpScout (SOP wikis & documentation)

-Basecamp (project & task coordination)

-Google Workspace 
, docs, sheets, drive)

-ChatGPT / Claude (AI-assisted drafting & research)

-A weather app set to Austin, TX (for weather-sensitive repair prioritization)



SCHEDULE



-Full-time (~40 hrs/week), Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central.

-This is a weekday role — no weekend work. Weekend and after-hours emergency coverage is handled by a separate tea
mber; you are responsible for a clean Friday handoff of any open or pending items.

-Remote — Philippines-based candidates only.

-First 90 days are a trial period; either party may end the engagement with 7 days' written notice. Compensation reviewed at 90 days and annually thereafter.



HIRING PROCESS



-Apply — Submit your resume and complete the TestGorilla assessments (link below). Please provide 2 professional references on your resume (recent supervisors or employers). We verify references and may contact prior employers directly.

-Screener Call — A 15-minute video call to discuss your experience.

-Trial Project — A short, scenario-based exercise reflecting real work-order situations you would handle in the role, including a recorded walkthrough of how you would solve them.

-Final Interview — Review your trial results and meet the team.



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, complete the TestGorilla assessments here: 

Your application must include:



-Your resume

-A 2-minute video (camera on, no slides) introducing yourself

-2 professional references

-Responses to the 3 maintenance questions on TestGorilla



Applications missing the video or written answers will not be reviewed. We look forward to reviewing your resume!

title: AI Developer
description:
We're looking for an AI-first developer who genuinely loves building and shows up with the plan. If you light up when you talk about wiring agents together, shipping internal tools fast, and using AI as a daily working partner, and you'd rather drive the build strategy than wait for a spec, we'd love to hear from you.



The Role



This is a gig-based, project-driven build role focused on internal tooling. Here's what you'd actually be doing:



- Building agents and automations from the ground up, including wiring up MCP servers and Claude Code workflows

- Building a range of internal tools for the team, the kind of things that remove manual work and speed up how we operate

- Working across APIs and integrations, including GoHighLevel, to connect the systems we run on

- Partnering with the team on what gets built and why. We work as a team to win, and you'd own the technical thinking on your side of it



Within the first 30 to 60 days, success looks like you showing up with the plan. You should be telling us what we should build next, how to approach it, and in what order. You should have a clear point of view on what's worth automating, what isn't, and what you want to ship first. The bar here is strategic ownership of the build, not waiting for a backlog to be handed to you.



Schedule



Work hours are flexible but need to overlap with our team between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST during active project work. Just want to make sure you can meet inside that window.



What We're Looking For



- An AI-first mindset. You use AI as a real working partner every day, and it shows in how you work.

- Independent problem-solving. You think first, use AI to amplify your thinking, and verify before shipping anything.

- A strategy-first approach. You're someone who shows up with the plan and tells us what we should be building, testing, and improving. You partner with our team on execution, but you lead the thinking on your work.

- Deep comfort with Claude Code, GitHub, Supabase, Vercel, working with APIs, and the GoHighLevel API. We're also genuinely interested in whatever else you've built your workflow around.

- A real love for this work. That comes through fast in conversation, and we'd rather hire someone who has it than someone who's just qualified.



How to Apply



A few things we'd love you to do, in order:



1. Please start your reply with the word "Jamal." We use this as a small check to spot applicants who read instructions carefully. Without it, we won't be able to review your application.



2. Record a 5-minute video answering the questions below. No script needed. We just want to get a feel for how you think.



3. Share your full tool stack with self-ratings (1 to 10). These ones we already know we need:

   - Claude Code    /10

   - GitHub    /10

   - Supabase    /10

   - Vercel    /10

   - Working with APIs    /10

   - GoHighLevel API    /10



   Then add every other tool you use, one per line, with /10. Include AI tools, frameworks, automation platforms, niche services, spreadsheets you've built, the works. Honesty matters more than scoring high. The video will give us a sense of where you actually are.



4. Walk us through your work history. For your last 2 or 3 clients or accounts:

   - What size was the company or account when you started (team size, what they were running, what was manual before you came in, whatever metric fits)?

   - What did you build for them?

   - What was the outcome? Where were they when you started, and where are they now?

   - If you have current clients, where are those projects today?



   We're trying to understand how you measure your own impact. The more specific, the better.



5. Quick confirmation that you can work somewhere inside the hours described above.



How You Use AI



In your video, spend a minute or so on this. The more specific the better:



- Which AI tools you use daily, weekly, and occasionally

- A specific example of a build task in this role where AI saves you real time, and how you use it

- A time AI gave you a wrong or bad output. How you caught it, and what you did about it

- Anything you've intentionally chosen NOT to let AI do in your work, and why



We're looking for real, lived examples. The specifics tell the story.



A Few Questions for Your Video



Take these in order, and just talk through them naturally.



1. If you came on next week and we asked you to build out our internal tooling, walk us through your first 30 days. What would you want to look at, what would you build first, and how would you d
 the order?

2. We hand you a vague request like "we need something to make X less painful," with no spec. Walk us through how you go from that sentence to a shipped tool.

3. An automation you built has started silently failing in production. Walk us through what you check first and how you track it down.

4. Why do you love building this kind of thing? Tell us about a recent tool or automation you shipped that reminded you why you do this work.

5. What's something about building with Claude Code, MCP, or agentic workflows that's changed in the last year that you've actually adjusted your approach around?

title: Healthcare Recruiter
description:
Hospice Healthcare Recruiter

Full-Time | Remote | Exclusive to White Orchid Hospice



White Orchid Hospice is looking for an experienced, highly motivated Hospice Healthcare Recruiter to lead full-cycle recruiting for all four of our hospice locations.



We are not looking for a passive recruiter who just posts jobs and waits. We want someone who knows how to find talent, create interest, build urgency, and close candidates. This role requires a recruiter who is confident, proactive, organized, and excellent at selling candidates on our company and opportunity.



If you have strong healthcare recruiting experience, direct hospice recruiting experience, and the ability to communicate naturally and confidently with Americans, we want to hear from you.



What You’ll Do

You will manage the recruiting process from start to finish across multiple locations. This includes sourcing candidates, reviewing resumes, screening applicants, coordinating interviews, following up consistently, helping move candidates through the hiring process, and supporting successful hires.



You must be able to recruit aggressively, keep pipelines active, and generate quality candidates for hospice-related openings. Just as importantly, you must be able to represent White Orchid Hospice well and effectively communicate why candidates should choose to join our team.



What We Need

You must have at least 5 years of healthcare recruiting experience and at least 2 years of direct hospice healthcare recruiting experience. This is required.



You must be fluent in English, both written and verbal, and able to communicate smoothly with Americans without the conversation feeling difficult or awkward because you are overseas.



You must be confident on calls, strong in candidate follow-up, and skilled at building trust and excitement with potential hires. We are looking for someone who can sell, not just screen.



This is a fully dedicated role. You must be committed exclusively to White Orchid Hospice and cannot have any other jobs, clients, contracts, or side work.



Ideal Candidate

The right person is aggressive, responsive, persuasive, and dependable. You know how to source, engage, and close healthcare talent. You understand the pace and demands of hospice recruiting. You are comfortable managing multiple openings at once and know how to stay organized, move fast, and communicate clearly.



Requirements

To be considered, you must meet all of the following:



Minimum 5 years of healthcare recruiting experience

Minimum 2 years of direct hospice healthcare recruiting experience

Strong English communication skills, both spoken and written

Ability to communicate comfortably and professionally with Americans

Proven ability to source, engage, and close candidates

Strong full-cycle recruiting experience

Must be fully dedicated to White Orchid Hospice only

No other active jobs, clients, or outside work commitments

Why This Role Matters

This is an important position for our organization. You will directly impact our ability to grow strong teams across all four locations. We need someone who can take ownership of recruiting, work with urgency, and help us hire great people who fit our mission and standards.



How to Apply

When applying, please include a short message answering the following:



How many years of healthcare recruiting experience do you have?

How many years of direct hospice recruiting experience do you have?

What hospice positions have you recruited for?

Are you currently working for any other employer or client?

Can you commit exclusively to White Orchid Hospice?

Why are you a strong fit for this role?

title: # Blog Publisher & Content Editor for Photography Company ($5/hr)
description:
# Blog Publisher & Content Editor for Photography Company ($5/hr)



$5/hour to start, with room for growth and added responsibilities for the right person.



Please read this entire post before applying.



We are NOT looking for someone who copies and pastes content into WordPress.



We are NOT looking for someone who generates generic AI articles and calls themselves a writer.



We are NOT looking for someone who needs constant supervision.



We ARE looking for someone who can take ownership of a blog post from draft to publication while protecting the voice of the brand.



To prove you read this entire post, begin your application with the word: WITNESSED



## About Us



We are a photography company based in New Jersey serving the New York and New Jersey area.



We photograph corporate headshots, personal branding sessions, corporate events, weddings, engagements, and proposals.



We publish a large amount of content and need someone who can help transform raw material into polished, professional blog posts that people actually enjoy reading.



## What You'll Be Doing



* Publishing blog posts in WordPress

* Editing content for grammar, clarity, flow, and readability

* Improving weak or awkward writing

* Maintaining a consistent brand voice

* Formatting articles for desktop and mobile readers

* Creating SEO titles and meta descriptions

* Writing image alt text

* Uploading and organizing images

* Adding internal links

* Formatting headings properly

* Embedding videos when appropriate

* Following publishing checklists and SOPs

* Occasionally writing sections of blog posts from notes, transcripts, outlines, or rough drafts

* Helping identify opportunities to improve existing content



## The Most Important Requirement



Writing ability.



WordPress can be taught.



SEO can be taught.



Writing instinct is much harder to teach.



Many people can summarize what happened.



Far fewer can make the reader feel like they were there.



For example:



"The bride was emotional during the first look with her father."



That is a summary.



A stronger writer notices details, reactions, expressions, body language, timing, and human behavior.



If that distinction makes immediate sense to you, keep reading.



## What We're Looking For



You should be:



* An excellent English writer

* Detail-oriented

title: Settlement Legal Assistant
description:
Job Description:



We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Settlement Legal Assistant to join our personal injury law firm. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in the settlement and case closing process by preparing settlement documentation, resolving medical liens and balances, coordinating settlement-related activities, communicating with medical providers and insurance companies, and ensuring cases move efficiently through the final stages of resolution. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong ownership of their workload, proactively managing tasks, tracking progress, following up on outstanding issues, and anticipating next steps without the need for frequent oversight.



Key Responsibilities:



• Settlement Statement Preparation & Review: Prepare settlement statements for attorney review, verify case expenses, review settlement-related documentation for accuracy and completeness, and ensure all required information has been obtained prior to disbursement.

• Medical Balance Verification & Resolution: Contact medical providers, hospitals, collection agencies, and lienholders to verify balances, obtain payment instructions and request updated billing information when necessary.

• Lien & Subrogation Resolution: Assist with Medicare, Medicaid, health insurance, MedPay, hospital lien, and subrogation matters by requesting final lien information, preparing reduction requests, tracking responses, and ensuring outstanding obligations are resolved.

• Settlement Documentation: Prepare payment letters, closure letters, reduction requests, MedPay correspondence, Medicaid compromise requests, Medicare documentation, and other settlement-related correspondence and forms.

• Client Communication: Communicate with clients throughout the settlement process, provide status updates, obtain information needed to finalize settlements, coordinate execution of settlement documents, and maintain a high level of client service.

• Follow-Up & Tracking: Monitor settlement timelines, track outstanding requests, follow up with medical providers, insurance companies, lienholders, and other parties, and document all communications and activities within the case management system.

• Settlement Disbursement Coordination: Assist with tracking settlement checks, preparing settlement disbursement documentation, confirming final balances, and ensuring all settlement-related requirements have been completed prior to case closure.

• File Organization & Case Closing: Ensure settlement documents are properly saved and organized, prepare closure documentation, coordinate final file organization, and assist with case closing procedures.

• Confidentiality: Handle sensitive client information in compliance with firm policies and all applicable laws and regulations.



Qualifications:



• High school diploma or equivalent; associate degree or paralegal training is a plus.

• Prior experience in a personal injury law firm or settlement department, with familiarity with liens, subrogation, settlement statements, and insurance claims processes, is strongly preferred.

• Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

• Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks while meeting deadlines.

• Ability to identify discrepancies, missing documentation, billing inconsistencies, and errors within case files.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to independently follow through on outstanding tasks and unresolved issues.

• Ability to communicate professionally and effectively with clients, medical providers, insurance companies, lienholders, and tea
mbers.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and case management software.

• Must have dual monitors and a dedicated laptop or desktop computer (Windows operating system required) to perform job duties effectively.



Work Schedule & Expectations:



• Full-time position, Monday through Friday

• 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM Central Standard Time (CST)

• Mandatory Monday Zoom huddle at 9:07 AM (CST), with cameras on to support engagement and team collaboration

To support productivity, accountability, and efficient workflow management in a remote environment, the firm may implement a time-tracking tool (such as DeskTime or a similar application). This is intended solely to promote transparency, optimize team performance, and ensure accurate tracking of work hours.



Why Join Our Team?



We are a dynamic law firm dedicated to delivering exceptional service to our clients in a supportive and collaborative environment. As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while continuing to develop your professional skills.



How to Apply:



Please submit your resume and cover letter outlining your relevant experience and why you are a strong fit for the Settlement Legal Assistant role at Collins Law, LLC. Be sure to include the word “Interested” at the top of your resume to demonstrate your attention to detail and enthusiasm for the position. Applications submitted without the word “Interested” at the top of the resume will not be considered.



Equal Opportunity Employer:



Collins Law, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all employees feel valued and respected.

title: 2D ANIME animator (ideally Moho)
description:
We are a US-based startup entertainment studio, and we’re looking for a highly skilled, expert-level 2D Animator (ideally moho, but open to adobe animate, toonboom, spine, etc). This is a YouTube project with videos focused on immersive storytelling and world-building documentaries. The style of artwork is Anime and while I know we can't reach the level of quality for something like Netflix's Castlevania, that is the target to emulate as best as we can while still moving fast. 



About the Project

We are creating an original IP brand, using a Japanese Anime art-style for a world of mythical creatures. It’s a dark fantasy set in Victorian England. The brand is like Pokemon meets Stranger Things. We are launching this universe through a new YouTube channel focused on high-quality animated storytelling.



While the YouTube channel is our starting point, our vision is massive. You will be getting in on the ground floor of a transmedia franchise that will eventually expand into trading card games (TCGs), board games, books, art toys, and more. Though the channel is brand new, it is backed by an experienced entrepreneur with a proven track record of building successful, profitable brands from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to serve as the foundational animator for a growing universe, bringing its creatures and lore to life from day one!



What You’ll Do

• Rig & Animate: Take finalized 2D anime-style character assets and environments and bring them to life using advanced 2D animation techniques. Videos will be probably about 50% character movement & 50?mera movement.

• Master a Hybrid Workflow: You will handle the bulk of the animation in Adobe (or the chosen software), but we might look into integrating AI tools like Seedance to animate the more complex scenes to maximize both efficiency and visual impact. Plus we will use AI for background and prop creation.

• Produce High-Quality Content: Animate engaging 10 to 15-minute videos using ready-made scripts, voiceovers, and provided art.

• Collaborate Globally: Work closely with our founder and an international remote team of character artists to ensure readability, pacing, and stylistic consistency.



What We’re Looking For

• 2D Expertise: Proven, expert-level experience in one: Moho, Adobe Animate, ToonBoom, Spine 2D, etc.

• AI Adaptability: A willingness to embrace and experiment with AI animation tools (like Seedance) to tackle challenging sequences.

• Pure Animation Focus: A strong portfolio showcasing your ability to take provided 2D anime-style assets and create expressive, cinematic animations. (No concept art or character design is required for this role).

• Cinematic Eye: A strong sense of rhythm, staging, camera movement, and smooth motion to keep long-form videos visually engaging.

• Vision & Adaptability: The ability to take creative direction and maintain a consistent animation style across multiple videos.

• Professionalism: Organized, responsible, and deadline-oriented.

• English Language Fluency: Must have conversational level English speaking (to understand feedback)

title: Microvellum Drafter — Remote (AU)
description:
1.  Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced cabinetry and joinery drafter to join our drafting team on a full-time, permanent basis. The successful applicant will work remotely from the Philippines, collaborating with our Australia-based senior drafters on commercial and residential joinery projects.



This is a salaried position rather than freelance or project-based contracting. Remuneration is paid monthly in Australian dollars by local Australian bank transfer or via Deel. The role operates on Australian Eastern Standard Time (7:00 am – 4:00 pm Manila time, Monday to Friday).



From commencement, the appointee will be responsible for producing shop drawings, cut lists and CNC nest files. The successful applicant will be inducted into our component library and internal standards; instruction in drafting fundamentals will not be provided. Work produced feeds directly into the Australian production workflow, in which clear communication, accurate documentation and on-time delivery are regarded as highly as drafting proficiency.



2.  Key Responsibilities

• Produce shop drawings, cut lists and three-dimensional models for cabinetry and joinery projects.

• Process approved drawings and prepare CNC-ready nest files for the production floor.

• Apply and maintain standard library components (panels, hardware and fittings) in accordance with internal standards.

• Interpret architectural drawings, specifications and site measurements provided by the Australian team.

• Revise drawings in response to site feedback, field dimensions and client changes within agreed turnaround times.



3.  Selection Criteria

Essential

• A minimum of one year of hands-on shop drawing experience in cabinetry or joinery, using any cabinetry CAD/CAM software (for example Microvellum, Cabinet Vision, Mozaik or KCDw), with the ability to work independently on standard tasks.

• Competence in CAD-based drafting and the ability to learn new software quickly (for example AutoCAD or SketchUp), including two-dimensional layout and basic three-dimensional modelling.

• A practical understanding of cabinet construction, including carcass types, hardware (such as Blum or Hettich) and sheet goods (MDF, melamine and PVC edging).

• Strong written and spoken English, sufficient for daily communication with Australian colleagues via Microsoft Teams and
.

• A reliable internet connection, stable and uninterrupted throughout working hours.

• A suitable home workstation running Windows 10 or 11, with a minimum of 16 GB RAM and a dedicated GPU. Company-provided equipment may be available for the right applicant.

• Availability Monday to Friday on Australian Eastern Standard Time (7:00 am – 4:00 pm Manila time).

• A disciplined, detail-focused approach, recognising that errors identified at the drawing stage prevent costly rework on the factory floor.

• Two to three samples of the applicant’s own drafting work (shop drawings, cut lists or CNC nest files), to be submitted with the application.

Desirable

• A diploma or degree in Drafting, Architecture, Interior Design, Civil or Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Experience across more than one cabinetry or joinery package (for example Microvellum, Cabinet Vision, KCDw or Mozaik).

• Familiarity with CNC manufacturing workflows, including nesting, beam saw programming and edgebanding.

• Experience with SketchUp, Revit, AutoCAD, Autodesk Inventor or Bluebeam Revu.



4.  Remuneration and Benefits

• A monthly salary of AU$1,600 – $2,200, paid in Australian dollars (approximately ?57,000 – ?78,000 at current exchange rates), commensurate with experience and reviewed annually.

• A permanent, salaried position offering consistent monthly income from commencement.

• A fully remote position based in the Philippines.

• Day-shift hours, Monday to Friday, 7:00 am – 4:00 pm Manila time.

• A structured four-week onboarding programme covering our software library, internal standards and project workflows.

• Additional benefits to be discussed at the offer stage.



5.  Application Process

Applicants should submit the following to 
 quoting the reference “Cabinetry & Joinery Drafter PH – [Applicant Name]” in the subject line:

• Curriculum vitae (PDF) — detailing software experience and clearly listing the cabinetry and joinery software used, together with years of experience.

• Cover letter — a brief letter describing a recent project delivered end-to-end (from drawing through to nest files) and the applicant’s role within it.

• Portfolio — two to three sample shop drawing sets personally produced by the applicant (PDF preferred).

• Technical confirmation — a screenshot of internet speed (from fast.com or speedtest.net) and the applicant’s computer specifications.



Selection process.  The selection process comprises a review of applications, a 30-minute video interview, a short practical drafting assessment, and an offer. We aim to progress applications within two to three weeks of receipt.
