title: Project Manager for Full-Service Marketing Agency
description:
Happy Friday! Thank you so much for taking the time to review our job posting.



Priority will be given to applicants who:

- Write an ORIGINAL cover letter/response that directly addresses our requirements (i.e. not copied/pasted to high-volume applications).

- Do NOT use ChatGPT / AI tools to write your cover letter. We want to meet YOU first — your voice, your thinking, your honesty. (We’re not anti-AI; we just want your application to reflect you.)



=====

ABOUT US

=====



We’re Agency — a small (intentionally small), values-centric fractional marketing team serving ambitious, ROI-driven clients.



We take our work seriously, but we also take care of each other. We’re big believers in:

- Clear communication

- Kindness + professionalism

- Doing excellent work without burning people out

- Building long-term working relationships (not revolving-door hiring)



If you’re the kind of person who takes pride in quality, communicates honestly, and likes being part of a team that truly supports one another — we’d love to hear from you.



=====

OUR MISSION

=====



Our fiduciary duty is to provide our clients with integrity-led marketing centered on measurable ROI and delivering value long after our work is done.



=====

OUR VALUES

=====



We hire for alignment with our values and candidate transparency/honesty above all else. We’re proud of how much our team cares — about our clients, about the work, and about doing right by each other.



Candor as a Compass

----------

Our word is our bond. We communicate honestly, clearly, and directly — even when it’s hard — because trust is everything.



Purpose Over Profit

----------

We only take partnerships we truly believe in, where we can deliver meaningful, lasting impact.



Double or Nothing Approach

----------

We aim for total conviction that every dollar billed is likely to return multiples in long-term value.



Data Tell the Story

----------

We prioritize based on evidence. If it doesn’t show up in the data, it doesn’t count.



Fail Forward Philosophy

----------

We take smart swings, learn fast, and improve relentlessly — without blame, ego, or drama.



=====

ROLE OVERVIEW

=====



We’re hiring a full-time Project Manager to run delivery across our client accounts and internal team.



This role is closer to a true marketing agency project manager (within a multi-service environment) than a basic coordinator. We need someone who can operate inside a complex ecosystem with frequent context switching, ambiguity, and multiple workstreams moving at once.



The goal of this hire is not simply “keeping tasks organized.”

The goal is meaningful operational lift: someone who can own timelines, unblock delivery, keep everyone aligned, and reduce the amount of context-loading and oversight required from senior tea
mbers.



This is a critical hire. Done right, it creates real bandwidth relief and a smoother client experience.



=====

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

=====



- Client deliverables ship on time, consistently, across multiple accounts

- Internal teams have clarity (what’s due, when, by whom, and what “done” looks like)

- Scope, priorities, and next steps stay clean even when clients change direction

- Fewer bottlenecks and fewer “surprises” (risks are surfaced early)

- Leadership spends less time chasing status and more time on high-leverage work

- Clients feel taken care of: proactive updates, clear coordination, and professional communication



=====

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

=====



Agency Delivery Ownership

- Own timelines, task execution flow, and day-to-day delivery across multiple client engagements

- Translate priorities into clear task plans with owners, due dates, dependencies, and definitions of done

- Run weekly (or as-needed) internal delivery check-ins and follow-ups

- Keep work moving even when inputs are missing (surface gaps early, propose next steps)



Cross-Functional Coordination (Multi-Service)

- Coordinate work across SEO, content, design, web/dev, paid media, analytics/reporting, and client comms

- Comfortably context-switch between accounts and workstreams without dropping details

- Track dependencies across functions (e.g., design needed before dev, copy needed before design, tracking needed before launch)



Client-Facing Communication + Follow-Through

- Proactively communicate status, timelines, and next steps to clients (clear, calm, professional)

- Maintain consistent follow-through internally and externally

- Surface risks early and propose solutions (not just “flagging problems”)



Systems + Operational Judgment

- Use and maintain our PM system at a high level (ideally ClickUp): task structure, documentation, recurring workflows, templates, and hygiene

- Create clarity in ambiguous situations using sound judgment, not constant escalation

- Identify recurring operational issues and improve the system (templates, SOPs, checklists, meeting cadence)



Reporting + Coordination Support

- Confident navigating spreadsheets, reporting workflows, and performance reporting processes

- Familiarity with marketing platforms from a coordination/reporting standpoint (GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads, etc.) even if you are not the one executing campaigns

- Ensure reporting deliverables and check-ins stay on schedule



Upwork Operations (Required)

- Manage contractor workflows and administrative coordination tied to Upwork

- Communicate clearly with freelancers, manage expectations, and keep deliverables on track

- Maintain Upwork-related organization and follow-through as part of our operating rhythm



=====

JOB REQUIREMENTS

=====



- Full-time (35–40 hours per week); flexible working hours

- Prompt communication and reliable follow-through

- A dependable computer, stable power, high-speed internet + backup hotspot

- Comfort using GSuite and basic Microsoft Office

- Ability to accept payroll via Wise (formerly TransferWise)

- Willingness to log hours using a time tracker (e.g. Hubstaff)



=====

REQUIRED SKILLS / TRAITS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

=====



- Honesty and candid communication — even when it’s uncomfortable

  (We can work through almost anything with transparency. Trust is the only thing we can’t rebuild once broken.)

- Strong project management instincts in a fast-moving environment with frequent context switching

- Proactive, detail-oriented communication with consistent follow-through (internal and client-facing)

- Strong operational judgment and ability to navigate ambiguity with minimal oversight

- Deep familiarity with PM systems (ideally ClickUp): task structuring, documentation, templates, and cross-functional coordination

- Experience coordinating reporting workflows (spreadsheets, dashboards, recurring reporting deliverables)

- Ability to keep multiple client workstreams on track simultaneously without needing constant context-loading

- High standards delivered with kindness (clear, direct, and professional without ego or harshness)



=====

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE (STRONGLY PREFERRED)

=====



- Experience working inside a multi-service marketing agency (SEO/content/PPC/web/dev workflows)

  (This is a major differentiator between a coordinator and a true agency PM.)

- Familiarity with the major marketing platforms from a coordination standpoint (GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads, HubSpot, etc.)

- Experience improving internal systems and operational processes (not just “running what already exists”)



=====

EXPECTATIONS

=====



- Your manager will be there for you — and we will set you up for success — but…

- After onboarding, you’ll be trusted with real autonomy and real accountability

- We expect proactive communication, early risk surfacing, and strong follow-through

- We have a strict policy against logging/billing hours when you aren’t actively working

- If you can’t reach expected hours in a given week (sick, power outage, etc.), tell us as soon as possible

- This role should create meaningful operational lift, not just coordination activity



=====

BENEFITS / HOW WE TAKE CARE OF OUR TEAM

=====



We work hard to build a place people actually want to stay — and we back that up with action.



- Paid Time Off (PTO) for full-time tea
mbers (after probation)

- Paid holidays, including a company-wide Christmas/New Year break (Dec 23 – Jan 1)

- Regular raises and performance-based growth opportunities



AND — one of our biggest commitments:

- After 12 months of full-time employment, you become eligible for our 4-day workweek benefit:

  - 25% pay raise, and

  - 20% reduction in hours

  (Example: moving from ~40 hours/week to ~32 hours/week while keeping earnings whole.)



We don’t offer that to sound impressive. We offer it because we care about sustainability, family, health, and long-term performance.



=====

HOW TO APPLY

=====



Please include:

1) A short ORIGINAL cover letter answering:

   - Why this role is a fit for you (specifically)

   - Your experience in agency environments (if applicable) and what services you’ve coordinated

   - Your comfort level with ClickUp (or similar) and Upwork (required)

   - A quick example of how you handled ambiguity and still kept delivery on track

   - Confirmation you’re comfortable with time tracking + full-time hours



2) A short summary of:

   - The types of clients/projects you’ve managed

   - The size and makeup of the teams you coordinated

   - The number of concurrent projects/accounts you typically handled



Optional (but helpful): include the phrase “Candor as a Compass” in your subject line so we know you read the full post.



=====

CLOSING

=====



Thank you again for your time and consideration. If you’re a high-integrity operator who loves bringing order to complexity — and you want to do it inside a team that genuinely supports you — we’d love to hear from you.



Have a wonderful rest of your week ahead.

About the company



Electi Delivery Services is a same-day B2B courier and logistics company based in Phoenix, Arizona. We move time-sensitive freight for healthcare clinics, auto dealerships, law firms, freight forwarders, and logistics companies. We're growing fast and need a cold calling VA who can open doors and generate qualified leads from decision-makers — not gatekeepers.



What you'll be doing

Making
outbound cold calls per day to US businesses in our target verticals, Calls are only about 1-3 mins each

Following a proven script and conversation flow to qualify decision-makers and book appointments

Handling objections confidently and pivoting naturally — not reading robotically from a script

Logging all call activity, outcomes, and notes in our outreach tracker (Google Sheets / Excel)

Flagging warm leads and hot prospects to ownership immediately for follow-up

Sending follow-up
s or texts after calls when directed

Attending a brief daily check-in with the team to review call performance and pipeline

Target industries you'll be calling

Healthcare — medical clinics, home health agencies, physical therapy offices, pharmacies

Auto dealerships — service departments, parts managers, general managers

Law firms — office managers, legal administrators

Freight forwarders and third-party logistics companies

Requirements

These are hard requirements. If you do not meet all of them, please do not apply.

Minimum 2 years of outbound cold calling experience — BPO call center background strongly preferred

Neutral or near-neutral American English accent — clear, confident, and professional on the phone

Experience selling to US businesses (B2B), not consumers

Proven ability to handle objections, gatekeepers, and difficult decision-makers

Stable internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps), reliable power, and a quiet work environment

Own headset and computer — no mobile-only applicants

Available to work Arizona / Mountain Standard Time business hours (MST, no daylight saving)

Comfortable using Google Sheets, Excel, and CRM or outreach tracking tools

What we're really looking for



We've hired VAs before. We know the difference between someone who can read a script and someone who can actually sell. We want the latter. You need to be able to hold a natural conversation, think on your feet when a prospect pushes back, and stay motivated through a high volume of dials without losing your energy or your professionalism.



If you've worked in a BPO selling services to US businesses, you know exactly what this role requires. That's our benchmark.



Who this is not for

Do not apply if you have only done customer service, data entry, or chat support. Do not apply if you have a heavy accent that affects call clarity, cannot work US business hours, or need a script read verbatim because you can't handle live objections. We will know within the first 30 seconds of a mock call.

Compensation

Competitive base rate commensurate with experience — state your rate expectation in your application

Performance bonuses available for qualified leads that convert to clients

Paid weekly

Long-term position for the right person — this is not a one-month contract there will be bonuses on top of salary pay



To be considered, you must complete all steps below. Missing any step = automatic disqualification.



Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.

How to apply (follow all steps)

Send your resume with a summary of your cold calling and BPO experience

Record a 60–90 second voice introduction — tell us who you are, your experience, and why you're the right fit. Upload to Google Drive or Dropbox and include the link.

Record a 2-minute mock cold call using this scenario: You are calling a Phoenix auto dealership and asking to speak with the service manager about same-day parts delivery. Handle at least one objection.

Answer the following screening questions in your message:

Screening questions

How many years of outbound cold calling experience do you have, and was it B2B or B2C?

Have you worked in a BPO call center? If yes, what product or service were you selling?

What CRM or outreach tracking tools have you used?

title: Long-Term Instagram Manager for Multiple Accounts (Room to Grow)
description:
Most social media jobs are short, scattered, and forgettable.

This one is meant to be the opposite.



We're looking for one dependable person to take real ownership of a set of Instagram accounts and stay with it for the long run. If you've been bouncing between small gigs and you're ready to settle into a single role where your work actually adds up over time and you get handed more as you earn it, this could be a good home.



Here's roughly how a day goes.

You open your accounts and get the day's content out, reels, feed posts, and stories, each one matching the voice of the account it belongs to. You spend real time in the comments and DMs, keeping things warm and human. You keep half an eye on what's working for similar accounts and what's trending, then fold the good ideas into what's coming up.



When a clip needs a quick trim or a cleaner cover, you sort it yourself in CapCut or Canva. At the end of the day you log what went out and how it performed in a shared Google Sheet, so we always have a clear read on every account. The quiet skill underneath all of it is keeping each account's style, schedule, and rules cleanly separate, so nothing ever bleeds from one into another.



This suits someone who genuinely likes order, gets a kick out of watching accounts grow off the back of steady daily effort, and would rather own one thing properly than juggle five things loosely. If you need someone checking in to keep you on task, or you want something light on the side, you'll be happier elsewhere, and that's fine.



To do this well, a few things aren't optional. You'll need a proper computer that can handle media work, not a phone or tablet. You'll need internet that's fast and stable, with some kind of backup for when the power or connection drops. Your written English has to be strong, since you're writing captions and talking to people all day. You'll need to be around most days, weekends included, because the accounts don't take days off. And you'll need to genuinely manage yourself. We won't be standing over your shoulder, and we don't want to.



What would put you near the top of the pile: real experience running several Instagram accounts at once. If you've handled ten or more, say so. Comfort in Google Sheets past the basics helps too, formulas, pivot tables, that kind of thing.



What you get in return: a steady long-term role instead of another short-lived gig, pay that reflects what you actually bring, and the chance to grow into more responsibility as you prove yourself, including a say in how the work gets done as things expand. You'd also be working with us directly, not lost under layers of management.



On how we hire: not off a polished resume and a hopeful note.

There's a detailed application first, then a short paid trial on real accounts before any offer goes out.

You're paid for that trial, because watching the real work is the only honest way for us to judge, and the only fair way for you to show what you can do.

title: CPG Product Development Manager | URGENT

About the Role:



We're looking for a driven and detail-oriented Product Development Manager with prior experience in CPG, food & beverage, pet, beauty, or consumer packaged goods manufacturing. You'll join our team and serve as the central engine behind new products, product modifications, new size launches, a packaging overhaul and product line management across our portfolio of brands. This is a cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of product, sourcing, and brand — and the right person thrives in both strategic and hands-on environments.



You'll partner closely with our brand teams, business managers, and procurement specialist to take product changes from concept to completion. You'll own the full lifecycle of each project and keep all the moving parts aligned.



What You'll Do:



Product Development & Modification



Lead and execute new products OR product changes across multiple brands — including new sizes, format changes, material updates, modifications, and dimension adjustments

Review and approve spec sheets, prototypes, and samples to ensure they meet brand and quality standards

Portfolio Knowledge & Product Consistency



Maintain a deep, working knowledge of the full product catalog across brands — understanding what exists, what is in development, and how products relate to each other across sizes and variants

Proactively identify and resolve inconsistencies across the portfolio — for example, if one size of a product carries a benefit or feature that another size does not, you flag it and drive alignment

Audit product lines for discrepancies in specs, sizing, materials,, or benefit claims and develop a plan to bring them into consistency

Partner with project managers and growth managers who own the catalog to ensure product development decisions are grounded in the full picture of what exists

Maintain organized records of product specs, supplier details, and project timelines to support cross-team visibility

Supplier & Procurement Collaboration



Work alongside our procurement specialist to source and qualify suppliers based on product requirements

Hand off supplier relationships once specifications are finalized, while staying engaged through launch to ensure alignment

Evaluate supplier capabilities against technical and brand requirements

Cross-Brand Coordination



Act as the central point of contact between brand teams, business managers, procurement, and operations

Manage multiple projects simultaneously across brands without letting anything fall through the cracks

Communicate project status, timelines, risks, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders

Sometimes you'll lead a project from scratch — other times you'll be handed a request and execute it. You're equally comfortable with both.

What We're Looking For:



Experience & Background



5–10 years of experience in product development, product management, or a closely related role

Background in CPG, food & beverage, pet, beauty, or consumer packaged goods manufacturing

Proven track record managing product changes across multiple brands or product lines simultaneously

Experience working with suppliers and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment

Skills & Abilities



Technically literate — you can read a spec sheet, understand materials and tolerances, and speak the language of consumer goods manufacturing

Hands-on experience with packaging development — dimensions, materials, structural specs, and print specs are not foreign to you

Strong project management skills — you keep projects on track without micromanaging

Excellent communicator across all levels, from the factory floor to brand leadership

Highly organized with strong attention to detail, especially when managing a large catalog of SKUs

Self-starter who can identify what needs to be done without being told, but also executes well when given direction

Comfortable with ambiguity — you can figure things out as you go

Nice to Have



Prior experience supporting or working within a procurement function

Experience managing private label or multi-brand portfolios

Who You'll Work With



You'll be embedded in a collaborative environment where you interact daily with brand teams, business managers, and our procurement specialist. You won't have direct reports in this role — but you'll have significant influence across the organization. The right person for this role leads through expertise, relationships, and results.



We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.





Application Question(s):

Do you have experience developing or commercializing physical consumer products — such as food, beverage, pet, beauty, or household goods? Yes / No

Have you managed product development across more than one brand or product line at the same time? Yes / No

Are you able to communicate professionally in English, both written and verbal? Our team operates globally and all cross-functional communication is conducted in English.

Accounts Payable & Vendor Communication: Play detective with our expenses. Conduct strict "three-way matching" to catch errors before payments go out. You will confidently get on the phone to speak with vendors to resolve billing disputes or clarify invoices.

Excellent English Phone Skills: Strong verbal and written communication. You must be fully comfortable picking up the phone to speak directly with US vendors and clients.

Software Proficiency: Strong hands-on experience with QuickBooks, (and similar accounting platforms) alongside standard Microsoft Office and Google Workspace tools—specifically requiring advanced Excel/Sheets skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUPs, data filtering).

The "Go-Getter" DNA: You are highly motivated, proactive, and eager to grow as part of a long-term team. You don't just wait for tasks—you anticipate needs.

title: Remote Accounting & Finance Specialist (Philippines)
description:
WeWearAustralian - Remote Accounting & Finance Specialist (Philippines)



Position Title: Finance, Accounting & Merchandise Planning Specialist

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Hours: Part-time to Full-time (flexible based on candidate)

Reporting To: Co-Founders, WeWearAustralian

Start Date: Immediate



About Us

WeWearAustralian is a premium Australian fashion retail concept based in SoHo, New York. We are Australia's first dedicated multi-brand fashion retail store in the United States, representing 25 independent Australian designers and labels.

We are a founder-led, fast-moving business at an exciting stage of growth. We are building a lean, high-performing remote team and are looking for a finance and accounting specialist who is sharp, detail-oriented, and genuinely interested in fashion and retail.



The Role

This is not a generic bookkeeping role. You will be the financial backbone of a multi-brand retail operation spanning the United States and Australia.

You will sit at the centre of our finance function, working daily across bookkeeping, brand reconciliations, merchandise planning, financial modelling, and board reporting. You will also work closely with our licensed US CPA firm and our Australian registered tax agent, acting as the primary point of coordination between the founders and our external accounting advisors in both jurisdictions.

This role is for someone who is technically strong, professionally confident, and capable of communicating clearly and independently with senior accounting professionals across two countries. Given the nature of our business and the people you will work with, native-level English fluency is essential - not preferred.



Key Responsibilities

Bookkeeping and Reconciliation



Daily and weekly bank reconciliation across all accounts

Accounts payable and receivable management

Credit card and expense reconciliation

Payroll records reconciliation (via Gusto, US payroll platform)

Xero data entry, categorisation, and maintenance across both US and Australian entities



Multi-Brand Reporting and Payments (25 Brands)



Monthly reconciliation of sales and stock data for each of our 25 brand partners

Preparation and distribution of individual monthly sales and stock reports to each brand

Calculation and processing of brand payments in line with consignment or wholesale agreements

Maintaining accurate brand-by-brand ledgers and payment histories

Liaising directly with brand partners or their finance contacts as required

Tracking outstanding payments, credits, and adjustments per brand



Inventory and Merchandise Planning



Tracking inventory levels across retail and e-commerce channels (Shopify)

Maintaining purchase order records and supplier payment schedules

Supporting open-to-buy planning and stock replenishment analysis

Monitoring sell-through rates by brand and category

Flagging slow-moving inventory and supporting markdown decisions



Australian Entity Compliance Support



Preparing BAS workings in Xero on a quarterly basis for review and lodgement by our Australian registered tax agent

Basic bookkeeping and account maintenance for the Australian entity

Acting as the primary liaison between the founders and our Australian tax agent

Ensuring all source documents and reconciliations are organised and ready ahead of each lodgement deadline

Maintaining clean, audit-ready records for the Australian entity



US Accounting and Compliance Support



Monthly close process support

Preparing workings and source documentation for our US CPA firm ahead of quarterly and annual filings

Acting as the primary day-to-day liaison between the founders and our US CPA firm

Responding to document requests from the CPA firm promptly and accurately

US sales tax record preparation and support

Maintaining organised, audit-ready financial records across the US entity



External Accountant Coordination



You will work alongside and take direction from our licensed US CPA firm and our Australian registered tax agent

You will not be expected to provide licensed accounting or tax advice yourself - that is the role of our external advisors

You will be expected to prepare accurate workings, ask intelligent questions, follow technical guidance, and implement recommendations correctly in Xero

Strong professional communication with external advisors is a core part of this role



Financial Modelling



Building and maintaining retail financial models covering P&L, cash flow, and working capital

Scenario modelling for new brand onboarding, buying decisions, and store expansion

Margin analysis by product category, brand, and channel

Budget vs actuals tracking and variance reporting



Board and Management Reporting



Preparing monthly management accounts in a clean, presentation-ready format

Drafting board reporting packs including KPIs, financial summaries, and narrative commentary

Tracking key retail metrics including sell-through, gross margin, revenue by channel, and inventory turn

Supporting investor reporting and capital raise documentation as required





What We Are Looking For

Non-Negotiable Requirements



Native-level English fluency - written and spoken. This is our single most important requirement. You will communicate directly with founders, brand partners, board members, and senior accounting professionals in both Australia and the United States. Your written and spoken English must be indistinguishable from that of a native speaker. Grammar, tone, and professional register matter enormously in this role.

A bachelor's degree or higher in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or Business. Please include your institution, degree, and GPA in your application.

CPA qualification (Philippines CPA) or currently completing CPA examinations

Minimum 3 years of experience in an accounting, finance, or commercial analysis role

Proven Xero proficiency - hands-on experience across both day-to-day bookkeeping and multi-entity management

Experience managing multi-party or multi-entity financial reporting

Comfortable working with Shopify data and reports

Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills including financial modelling

Proven ability to liaise professionally with external accountants, auditors, or advisors



Strong Preference Given To



Candidates who completed their undergraduate or postgraduate degree in the United States or Australia. We regard this as a significant indicator of English proficiency, cultural alignment, and professional communication standard. Please highlight this prominently in your application if it applies to you.

Candidates who have lived, worked, or studied in an English-speaking country for an extended period

Candidates who can demonstrate through their cover letter and application materials that their English is genuinely exceptional - not just functional



Also Highly Regarded



Prior experience supporting a US-based and/or Australian business

Familiarity with Australian GST, BAS preparation, and ATO compliance processes

Background in fashion, retail, or e-commerce

Experience preparing board or investor reporting packs

Exposure to merchandise planning or open-to-buy processes

Familiarity with consignment accounting and multi-brand reconciliation

Knowledge of US GAAP, US sales tax, or multi-state compliance





The Kind of Person We Want



Your English is genuinely excellent - your writing is clear, considered, and professional without effort

You studied in the US, Australia, or another English-speaking country, or have spent significant time working in one

You are proactive and commercially curious - you want to understand the business, not just process transactions

You are comfortable managing 25 brand relationships simultaneously with precision and care

You take direction well from senior advisors and implement it accurately

You ask smart questions rather than making assumptions

You are reliable, organised, and take ownership of your workload

You understand that in a founder-led business, speed, accuracy, and communication are everything





Compensation



Competitive rate based on experience and qualifications

Please include your expected monthly rate (USD) in your application

Long-term engagement for the right candidate





How to Apply (please do not apply unless you qualify on all fronts)

Please send the following:



A cover letter written entirely by you. This is the first thing we will read and we will be assessing your written English from the opening sentence. Write it as you would a professional business communication - clear, structured, and confident. Do not use AI to write this letter. Applications with generic or AI-generated cover letters will not proceed.

Your CV including your institution, degree, GPA, and CPA status. If you studied in the United States or Australia, please make this prominent at the top of your CV.

Your software proficiencies, particularly Xero, Shopify, and Excel or Google Sheets

Two to three examples of financial reports, models, or board packs you have prepared (anonymised if needed)

Your expected monthly rate in USD

Your available working hours and timezone overlap with New York (EST)



We read every application carefully. If your English, qualifications, and experience align with what we have described above, we will be in touch promptly.

mbers

mber who understands the current workflow

THE ROLE

polished, engaging YouTube videos (10–25 min) and short-form clips (Reels/Shorts). This is an

ongoing, part-time remote role — initially 1–2 videos/month, growing over time.



WHAT YOU'LL EDIT

- YouTube long-form: cultural commentary, ride vlogs, founder stories

- Short-form clips: 3–5 clips per video for Instagram/TikTok

- Thumbnails: guidance provided, execution by you



EDITING STYLE

Talking head, Documentary-style, and occasional vlog long-form. The editing should feel unhurried but tight — warm, cinematic, and human. No flashy transitions, no hyperspeed cuts. B-roll should earn its place. Think magazine, not

vlog. Short-form clips should stand alone and hook within 3 seconds. Strong SFX and use of sound/music to enhance the story.



REQUIREMENTS

- Strong portfolio of YouTube long-form content

- Proficiency in DaVinci Resolve 

- Proficiency in motion graphics, animation titles

- Experience creating short-form clips from long-form

- Strong English (written and spoken) — you'll communicate via async video/Loom

- Reliable internet, own equipment

- Available for async communication (no live calls required)



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with outdoor/lifestyle/cycling/golf content

- Motion graphics / animation

- Thumbnail design (Photoshop or Figma)

title: Google Ads Expert
description:
We're looking for an AI-first Google Ads expert who genuinely loves this work and shows up with the plan. If you light up when you're building a Search or PMax campaign from scratch, use AI as a daily working partner, and prefer driving strategy over taking tasks, we'd love to hear from you.



The Role



- You'll build and manage multiple Google Ads (and Microsoft Ads) accounts from the ground up, across both ecommerce and lead generation clients.

- Most of the work lives in Search and Performance Max, with other campaign types layered in when the account calls for it.

- You'll partner with our team to win. We share the wins and we share the work, but you'll lead the thinking on the accounts you own.

- Success in your first 30 to 60 days looks like you showing up with the plan. You're telling us what we should be testing, why, and when. You have a clear point of view on what's working across each account, what isn't, and what you want to try next. The bar is strategic ownership.



Schedule



You'll work part-time hours that fall somewhere between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST. We'll set the exact schedule together. There's a real path to full-time as the work grows, so we'd love to know you're open to that conversation down the road. Just want to make sure you can work somewhere inside that window.



What We're Looking For



- An AI-first mindset. You use AI as a real working partner every day, and it shows in how you work.

- Independent problem-solving. You think first, use AI to amplify your thinking, and verify before sending anything off.

- A strategy-first approach. You're someone who shows up with the plan and tells us what we should be doing, testing, and improving. You partner with our team on execution, but you lead the thinking on your work.

- Deep comfort in Google Ads, GA4, and Search Console. You can navigate them without thinking and read the data without guessing.

- Experience running paid search across both ecommerce and lead generation. Both motions are part of the work, so you should be confident in each.

- A real love for this work. That comes through fast in conversation, and we'd rather hire someone who has it than someone who's just qualified.



How to Apply



A few things we'd love you to do, in order.



1. Please start your reply with the word "Jamal." We use this as a small check to spot applicants who read instructions carefully. Without it, we won't be able to review your application.



2. Record a 5-minute video answering the questions below. No script needed. We just want to get a feel for how you think.



3. Share your full tool stack with self-ratings (1 to 10). These ones we already know we need.

   - Google Ads    /10

   - GA4    /10

   - Search Console    /10



Then add every other tool you use, one per line, with a /10. Include Microsoft Ads if you've used it, AI tools, spreadsheets you've built, niche platforms, the works. Honesty matters more than scoring high. The video will give us a sense of where you actually are.



4. Walk us through your work history. For your last 2 or 3 clients or accounts.

   - What size was the account when you started (ad spend, revenue, lead volume, whatever metric fits the role)?

   - What did you do for them?

   - What was the outcome? Where were they when you started, and where are they now?

   - If you have current clients, where are those accounts today?



We're trying to understand how you measure your own impact. The more specific, the better.



5. Quick confirmation that you can work somewhere inside the hours described above.



How You Use AI



In your video, spend a minute or so on this. The more specific the better.



- Which AI tools you use daily, weekly, and occasionally

- A specific example of a task in Google Ads where AI saves you real time, and how you use it

- A time AI gave you a wrong or bad output. How you caught it, and what you did about it

- Anything you've intentionally chosen NOT to let AI do in your work, and why



We're looking for real, lived examples. The specifics tell the story.



A Few Questions for Your Video



Take these in order, and just talk through them naturally.



1. If you took over a Google Ads account on day one for an ecommerce or lead gen client, walk us through what you'd want to look at in your first week and what your first hypothesis to test would be.

2. Walk us through how you'd diagnose a Search campaign that's spending well but not converting. What do you check, in what order, and why?

3. Tell us about a time you disagreed with a client or stakeholder about how a Google Ads account should be structured. What did you push back on, how did you handle it, and what happened?

4. Why do you love this work? Tell us about a recent campaign or 
nt that reminded you why you do it.

5. What's changed about how you structure and signal Google Ads campaigns in the last 12 months (PMax asset groups, search themes, AI Max for Search, broad match plus smart bidding, whatever you've adjusted to)? What's working for you right now and what isn't?

title: Experienced Lead Manager (Real Estate)
description:
We are hiring a Lead Manager to nurture and manage our pipeline of real estate leads, ensuring no opportunities slip through the cracks. As a Lead Manager, you will be the main point of contact for warm leads: following up with prospects, building rapport, and guiding them until they are ready to close or speak with our acquisitions closer. Additionally, you will engage in targeted outbound prospecting, using our high-quality data (e.g. fresh county records for probate and foreclosures) to initiate conversations with potential sellers. This hybrid role is critical – you'll keep our funnel organized and full by both managing incoming leads and proactively hunting new ones. If you are a people-person who is also organized and driven, this could be a perfect fit.



Who We Are: The OmniKey Group is founded and led by top-ranking Fortune 500 Sales Managers with a proven track record of developing and employing elite talent. We don't just build businesses — we build careers. As we scale aggressively, we are looking for driven individuals who want to grow alongside a leadership team that knows how to invest in people.



Responsibilities:

Lead Nurturing: Manage a pipeline of ~50 active leads in our CRM. Promptly follow up with interested home sellers via phone, text, and
. Your goal is to build relationships over time – check in regularly, understand their situation, and keep our company top-of-mind for when they're ready to sell.

Initial Lead Qualification: Call new inquiries (from inbound calls or web forms) as soon as they come in. Have a friendly introductory conversation to gather information: Why might they sell? When? What's the property condition? Identify serious motivation versus casual interest. Ensure every new lead is contacted and categorized (hot, warm, long-term, etc.).

Set Appointments: When a lead is qualified and shows strong interest/motivation, schedule an appointment or transfer the call to our acquisitions closer. You control the calendar for our acquisition team – scheduling consultations or property visits. Make sure our closer gets all key information before the meeting.

Outbound Prospecting: Devote part of your time to reaching out to cold prospects from our premium data lists (such as probate, pre-foreclosure, or other niche lists we've pulled). Use cold calling or personalized texts/emails to introduce our service and see if they have a property they might consider selling. This "deep prospecting" uses the valuable data provided by our Data Manager to generate new leads beyond the ones who come to us.

Pipeline Organization: Keep the CRM updated meticulously. Log every call, update lead statuses, and add detailed notes after each contact. Set follow-up reminders for each lead so you always remember to call back when promised. No lead should ever be forgotten or left without a next action.

Team Coordination: Work closely with the acquisitions (closing) team. Clearly hand off highly motivated leads with full context (notes about the seller's situation, motivation level, etc.). After our closer makes an offer, circle back with the seller to address any concerns or continue nurturing if they didn't sign immediately. Essentially, you bridge the gap between initial interest and closed deal, keeping communication smooth.



Requirements:

Excellent Communication: Fluent English speaker who can converse naturally and confidently with U.S. homeowners. You have a friendly phone demeanor, active listening skills, and can build trust over multiple conversations. (Experience talking to older American homeowners is a plus – you can strike the right tone of patience and professionalism.)

Sales/Customer Service Experience: 1+ year in a role like sales representative, account manager, customer service, or any position requiring consistent client follow-up. Real estate experience (especially in investing or related to motivated sellers) is highly advantageous – if you've dealt with sellers or real estate leads before, let us know!

Follow-Up and Organizational Skills: A proven ability to juggle dozens of leads and keep an organized system. You never let a task or callback slip. Using a CRM or lead management system should be second nature to you. (If you pride yourself on color-coded spreadsheets or meticulous task lists, that's a good sign!)Google Drive



Persuasion & Empathy: You know how to connect with people, ask the right questions, and handle objections. You're empathetic to sellers' situations (many may be in tough circumstances like foreclosure, probate, etc.) and also persuasive in highlighting how our service can help them.



Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with CRM software, click-to-call phone systems, and general productivity tools (Google Workspace, etc.). Able to learn new apps quickly. Also, must have reliable internet and a headset/quiet workspace for frequent calls.

Work Hours: Available to work full-time on US hours (e.g. 9am–6pm PST). Leads must be called quickly during da
 hours in the US. Flexibility to occasionally adjust hours for an urgent lead is appreciated. We are seeking someone who can commit long-term (12+ months) and become an integral part of the team.



What We Offer:

Base Pay + Commission: Competitive base salary plus commission on each deal you help close. Your earning potential grows with every deal.

Impactful Work: This role is at the heart of our business – you will directly influence our revenue by turning leads into deals. It's rewarding to see your relationship-building result in a family helped and a successful transaction. We often deal with homeowners in difficult situations; you'll take pride in guiding them toward a solution.

Training & Development: We will provide training on our scripts, CRM, and the real estate investment process. You'll learn about the wholesale home-buying industry, negotiations, and how to evaluate seller motivation. Ongoing coaching will be available to sharpen your skills (we succeed when you succeed).



Team Environment: Work with a supportive, growth-minded team. We maintain open communication and regular team check-ins despite being remote. You'll get feedback and recognition for your hard work. We also encourage new ideas – if you have suggestions to improve our follow-up processes, we want to hear them.



Remote Work Lifestyle: This is a 100% remote position. Save on commute time and work from the comfort of your home (or home office). As long as you can reliably cover the required hours and stay connected, you'll enjoy the flexibility of remote work.



How to Apply: If you're excited about nurturing leads and driving deals, we'd love to hear from you. Please send your resume and a short voice recording introducing yourself. In your intro, tell us why you're interested in this Lead Manager role and highlight any relevant experience (especially in real estate or sales). You can use a service like Vocaroo for the recording and share the link. Feel free to also include a brief note or cover letter about a time you successfully convinced a customer or closed a tough deal – we value those who take initiative to showcase their skills. Qualified candidates will be invited to a Zoom interview (and possibly a role-play exercise). Come join a team where your follow-up prowess will be highly valued and rewarded!
